name: hash-bonsai-gardener
description: Writes Hash Bonsai's weekly report from chain facts, stores it on Walrus as an undeletable blob, and learns across epochs with Walrus Memory.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/gardener.mjs && esbuild src/approve.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/approve.mjs && esbuild src/reject.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/reject.mjs && esbuild src/redo.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/redo.mjs && esbuild scripts/backfill.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/backfill.mjs
